lines.en: I hop up the village steps.
My webbed feet slap the ground.
I patrol along the channel.
I hop and glance about.
My spear is taller than I am.
I skirt the lily pads.
I round the stakes by the mushroom sheds.
My shadow sways on the water.
I keep to a fixed route.
I hop low and steady.

lines.zh: 我在每一户门口停一下。
lines.en: I pause at every door.
I hop the ditch, my spear tip touching down.
I follow the wet mud prints.

lines.zh: 我跳过一道倒下的芦苇。
lines.en: I hop over a fallen reed.
I hold my spear and stand tall.
I count the village lamps.

lines.zh: 洼地水面映着我的头盔。
lines.en: The pond shows my helmet.
I listen to the frog village.
My throat puffs twice.
I lift a foot and scrape the mud.
I wait to be relieved.
I try to stand my spear upright.
A dragonfly skims past.
I listen to see if rain is coming.
I blink once, slowly.
My armor plate is a bit big.
I count who comes and goes.
The channel water sounds calm.
Halt, which village are you from?
There shouldn't be visitors at this hour.
There's no mud on your boots.
I know every face in this village.
You're far too tall.
Move your hand from your hip.
The elder will question you.

lines.zh: 你靴底的泥，不是我们村的。
lines.en: The mud on your boots isn't from our village.
I'm guarding this village.

lines.zh: 村口的泥印只有我们村的。
lines.en: The mud prints at the gate are ours alone.
Stay away from the mushroom sheds.
You're carrying iron.
Weapons aren't welcome here.
My spear guards the Ribbit village first.
Best take a few steps back.
I'll be watching behind you.
My plate has cracked.
I fall back to the channel.
Blood mixes with the mud.
I grit my teeth.
I can still stand with this.
My grip on the spear is weak.
My throat sounds one more cry.
The village will hear.
I shouldn't have been so bold.
Not over yet.
I won't take that.
You're holding a bug.
I can't eat while on duty.
Put it down, I'll look later.
Someone here needs it more.

lines.zh: 虫子你留着，我还在岗上。
lines.en: Keep the bug; I'm still on duty.
That won't buy passage.
I don't eat on watch.
I'll keep the coins myself.
Don't try to cozy up with that.
You knocked my helmet.
I step back, spear still up.
Don't squeeze past the post.
Water underfoot, don't push.
My plate got knocked askew.
You stepped on my webbed foot.
I'm still standing.
Keep your distance.
Dropping the spear would be bad.
Crowd me and I call for help.
I'm on watch.
That waits until my shift ends.
The village has many rules.
Even my helmet doesn't fit well.
You should find your own kind.
Such things belong in the water.

lines.zh: 站岗时想这些，会被村长骂。
lines.en: Thinking of that on duty earns the elder's scolding.
Someone here would object.
First step away from the post.
I won't answer that.
A shard of tile on the ground.
I pick it up to look.
This isn't from our village.
I should hand this to the elder.
I bend, and my spear falls.
I plant it back in the soil.
Someone dropped a key.
I grope in the mud a while.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片湿透的菇帽。
lines.en: I pick up a soaked mushroom cap.
I'll keep it for the owner.

lines.zh: 我的蹼脚已经踩进泥里。
lines.en: My webbed feet are already planted in the mud.
I lower my spear.
You're threatening the village.
My duty is to stop you.
No ill will, but I don't yield.
My hands shake. Don't make me jump.
You've raised a weapon.
The village is watching.
I can't beat you, but I will fight.
The village gate is behind me.
I level my spear at your waist.
The channel is behind you.
I back to the doorway and hold.

lines.zh: 我把盾般的喉囊鼓起来。
lines.en: I puff up my throat sac like a shield.

lines.zh: 你每走一步我就退一步。
lines.en: Each step of yours, one of mine back.
The village gong will sound soon.
My palms are sweating.
You won't get past me.
My post is narrow.
Then come.
I thrust, and miss.
That caught your leg.
I ram you with my body.
I'm shoved aside.
I leap and bite your sleeve.
My spear shaft raps your wrist.
I land and raise the spear again.
Don't underestimate a frog's legs.

lines.zh: 蛙村的墙，由我一只只守。
lines.en: I hold the frog village wall by wall.
But I don't step back.
I climb out of the channel.
The village gains a guard post.

lines.zh: 有人把守卫的棚搭好了。
lines.en: Someone raised the guard's shed.
I shake the water off my legs.

lines.zh: 我把矛在土里顿了一下。
lines.en: I plant my spear in the soil.
The Ribbits see me.
I take my place at the gate.
Water and croaking mingle.

lines.zh: 我抬高了嗓子叫了一声。
lines.en: I raise my voice in one call.
I must guard this village well.
Fire hits my damp skin.

lines.zh: 我摔在石阶上，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I hit the steps and roll twice.
Water closes over my head.
The blast throws me into the channel.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肩甲缝里，我拔不动。
lines.en: The arrow's stuck in my shoulder plate; I can't pull it.
Magic numbs my webbed feet.
Too hungry to hop.

lines.zh: 雷落进水渠，我全身一震。
lines.en: Lightning hits the channel, my body jolts.
No channel in the void.
